about: NeoForge's own classes that convert copies (neoforge-sources.txt) which call a member only NeoForge's patches add to a game class, rewritten on the game's own members: each text is replaced in the copy, and the access transformer lines that needs are added to the mod's access widener (only when the class is copied).

net.neoforged.neoforge.common.conditions.about: NeoForge's RegistryOps(RegistryOps other) copies the other's delegate and lookup provider; the game's constructor takes them.

net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.Attri.about: NeoForge adds player() and level() to the game's Item.TooltipContext; the context declares them itself, and its level is the player's (the game's context does not give its level).
